authorization.request: 检查一下 github里面的用户回复
authorization.priorActionAuthorization: 改回复的回复 改修复的修复 该关闭的关闭
authorization.writeRoute: GitHub integration for source PR; GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN for the guarded sender
authorization.outreach: main-reviewed request-specific plan and central immutable-person CAS only

gates: exact base and reviewed file hashes
current request identity/body/time and complete history before reservation
one central CAS reservation and no uncertain retries

rollback.source: CI checked PR revert with recoverable Git history
rollback.contacts: never delete reservations or repeat uncertain sends

healthCheck: Exact reply body readback and matching permanent request reservation; no Catalog or Profile changes
